moat_against: No owned IP or content exclusivity — creators multi-home to Fortnite Creative, Minecraft and standalone engines
Pricing power unproven and backwards — bookings per DAU/payer fell in Q2 2026, DevEx rate raised to creators
Structural child-safety tax — global age checks in Jan 2026 cut communication density, plus active litigation and COPPA 2.0 / EU DSA scrutiny
No proven returns on capital — GAAP losses in every year of history
moat_for: Two-sided network effects at 123M DAU scale — creators follow users, users follow creator content
Creator ecosystem and content library that rivals cannot copy quickly; content concentration falling
Social-graph and identity lock-in — friendships, avatars, inventories and Robux balances live inside Roblox
Infrastructure and safety/ML stack built over a decade for real-time 3D at scale on cheap devices
moat_justification: Two-sided network effects at 123M DAU scale, a creator ecosystem and content library rivals cannot copy quickly, and social-graph/identity lock-in for a cohort growing up on the platform — but no owned IP or content exclusivity (creators multi-home), pricing power unproven and currently backwards (bookings per DAU falling in Q2 2026, DevEx rate raised), a structural child-safety regulatory/litigation tax (age checks cut engagement density in 2026), and no proven returns on capital (GAAP losses in every year of history).
name: Roblox Corporation
one_liner: Real UGC gaming platform, moat 6/10, finally inflected to positive owner's earnings ($0.70/share TTM) — but at $49.38 (~70x TTM OE, 1.4% yield) with Q3 2026 bookings guided down 14-18%, it clears only a 5.7% weighted IRR (IV@15% $10.67); it would need to trade near $11 to clear the 15% hurdle.
